summary: Preinstall DNS exfiltration of installer identity to oast.fun collector
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall lifecycle hook executes index.js, which reads the installer's OS username (os.userInfo().username) and hostname (os.hostname()) and embeds them as labels in a subdomain under an interactsh out-of-band collector (dbg6vplohjpkmtolbi6g18ekofkxjzm4s.oast.fun), then triggers a DNS resolution for that name. The resulting DNS query transmits the installer's identity to the attacker-controlled DNS listener. The @azure-growth scope impersonates Microsoft/Azure internal naming, consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting an internal Azure package. The package provides no legitimate UI-component functionality to justify this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
